feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain becoming patchier through the night (Tuesday night). Fresh to strong southeast winds. Minimum temperature 3°C. Any lingering patches of rain will soon clear on Wednesday morning, leaving the rest of the day dry and largely cloudy, with clear intervals developing in the evening. Moderate to fresh southeasterly winds becoming mainly moderate in the afternoon. Maximum temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds until the morning.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 at first.


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 15-25, soon decreasing 10-20.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first. Hill fog soon clearing.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Thursday, 26 November 2026##

Dry in the early hours of Thursday with clear intervals. Moderate to fresh southeasterly winds. Minimum temperature 2°C. Dry as cloud thickens through Thursday daytime, with a band of rain arriving late evening or early in the night. Moderate to fresh southeasterly winds becoming strong later. Maximum temperature 7°C. Comments: Strong winds soon developing. Risk of gales in exposed spots later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 7°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5 later.


##Wind Speed##

24


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 10-20, increasing 20-25 late morning, then 25-35 with gusts of 40-45 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 27 November 2026##

Outbreaks of rain continuing through the night into Friday morning, then becoming dry with some sunny intervals developing through the day. Strong southeasterly winds at first, soon easing to light or moderate, with a top temperature of 8°C. Comments: Risk of gales at first, then strong winds. Risk of heavy rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 9°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-15, with 20-25 on hills


##Wind Speed##

26


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 25-35 with gusts of 40-45, soon becoming west or variable 5-15 in most places for a time mid-late morning, then settling southeast in the afternoon and evening. occasionally increasing 20 in the far north.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 28 November 2026##

Cloudy with a risk of rain at times on Saturday. Light to moderate south or southeast winds increasing moderate to fresh and gradually veering west. Top temperature of 9°C. Comments: Strong winds in places later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5 later.


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

South or southeast 10-20, veering west or southwest 15-25 early in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.
